$comment: Destructive calls a template reaches with no confirmation on the path, as they stand today (QA CX-010).
Each key is "file::unconfirmed::handler->Service.method"; "why" says why one click is right, or its defect id.
A site not listed fails the build: ask with ConfirmService.ask(), or send it from <app-confirm-dialog> / <app-reason-dialog>, then delete its pin.

src/app/pharmacy/dispensing.html::unconf.why: the Confirm button of an inline panel the row's action opened: the panel names the action, takes the reason and offers Cancel, so opening it IS the question
the Confirm button of an inline panel the row's action opened: it takes the reason and the witness and offers Cancel, so opening it IS the question

src/app/super-admin/emergency/emergency..why: the typed phrase FORCE LOGOUT ALL is the confirmation (it refuses until typed exactly; emergency.spec.ts drives it): stronger than a yes/no
